sources.observation: Pale fluted roots cross the mottled gallery roof and reach down around the open sandstone doorway.

sources.credit: Radek Kucharski / Wikimedia Commons, credit and license on the linked photo page
sources.observation: The main causeway enters between low stone guardrails and faces a tall, tiered gopura between the roofed galleries.

sources.credit: Gzzz / Wikimedia Commons, credit and license on the linked photo page
sources.observation: Broken stepped cornices, mossy vaults and partly buried loose blocks form the inner ruin courts.

limitations: The model covers the principal four inner enclosures, selected shrine footprints and five trees. Individual carved reliefs, damaged masonry and canopy shapes interpret the photographs. The outer park and its independent gateways remain host map features.
